summary: This round adds `normalizeHost`, which strips only the public origin's default port from a Host header. It is used for the main-host check, the upgrade guard and the creator-subdomain check, so `gethalo.dev:443` and `alice.gethalo.dev:443` resolve the same way as the bare hosts. The logic fails closed for lookalike and non-default-port hosts. The new durable `creatorHost.test.ts` is a fast unit test that guards this host-isolation boundary, so I accept it as durable. Both test runs pass, every changed line is covered or exempt with an accepted reason, and no P0 or P1 finding remains.
